STUDY BOUNDARIES

A precise scope. An honest record.

Only ABCD1 variants explicitly labeled Pathogenic by the adrenoleukodystrophy.info registry qualify as study targets. Likely pathogenic, VUS, NBS-associated, benign, and unlisted variants are excluded. Other resources provide annotations and background without expanding eligibility.

Cerebral ALD, adrenomyeloneuropathy, adrenal involvement, and presymptomatic settings are evaluated separately. A pathogenicity label does not establish phenotype, prognosis, or a preferred therapy.

This is an independent research tracker for scientific transparency. It does not provide patient-specific treatment recommendations. No identifiable patient records are published here.
